title: KPN brings the Netherlands together behind 'Oranje' during the 2026 World Cup
text: 29 May 2026 | 09:08 Europe/Amsterdam KPN brings the Netherlands together behind 'Oranje' during the 2026 World Cup This will be a World Cup of superlatives. The biggest football event on Earth, ever. No one wants to miss it. But with a distance of 6,000 kilometers, the chance of being there in person is slim. KPN is helping the Netherlands experience the World Cup – even right at home – better than ever. With KPN SuperFiber, you don't have to cross the ocean; the World Cup will be SUPER at home too. The 2026 World Cup will be bigger than ever, with 48 countries, 16 host cities, and 104 matches spread across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. As a result, the tournament is growing into the global sporting event where the Netherlands will also come together en masse for Oranje . The ultimate World Cup experience starts at home Precisely because the majority of fans are experiencing the World Cup from home, KPN positions itself as the indispensable link in that experience. With super-fast and super-stable fiber optic internet and high-quality TV services, KPN ensures that viewers can optimally follow every moment of the Dutch team, from the first whistle to the final penalty. The campaign capitalizes on the numerous viewing moments, the enormous reach, and the high engagement surrounding the tournament. In doing so, KPN claims a clear role: enabling the ultimate World Cup experience, right at home. Louis as the face of the campaign and SUPER predictor Louis, KPN's famous cat, plays a leading role in the campaign. In the World Cup commercial and throughout the tournament, he is present everywhere as a recognizable and connecting face. During the World Cup, Louis acts as a 'SUPER predictor', playfully analyzing matches and making predictions regarding the Dutch team. In doing so, he brings fans closer to the game and ensures extra engagement and recognition throughout the entire tournament. Louis also constantly returns in social formats and activations, becoming the face of how the Netherlands experiences the World Cup via KPN. From farewell to the final: continuously close to the Dutch team KPN is visible throughout the entire World Cup, from the run-up with the farewell match through to the decisive phases of the tournament. The campaign follows the rhythm of the World Cup and peaks at the moments that matter, such as match days for the Dutch national team. Fans are continuously engaged with content and activations, ranging from social formats and live content to exclusive events such as fan experiences at the KNVB Campus. The World Cup also plays an important role in the MijnKPN app, with promotions and activations that involve customers in the tournament on a weekly basis. Together with Albert Heijn behind Oranje Part of the campaign is the collaboration between KPN and Albert Heijn. In it, two iconic worlds come together: Louis and the famous Albert Heijn hamsters. In joint content, they show that they stand behind Oranje together and are turning it into a fun Orange party. This crossover is visible on social media and Albert Heijn's AH.nl delivery vans, among other places. The TV commercials for both brands also contain a mutual wink, extending the Orange feeling across a wide range. KPN x AH Download Media Kit Preparing your download... Download An error occurred while preparing your download Personalized Orange World Cup cases for fans The collaboration goes beyond just communication. Especially for the World Cup, KPN is bringing back a popular promotion: personalized Orange phone cases available to order online. Pop-up locations are being set up in selected Albert Heijn XL stores where Orange fans can have their cases made immediately. This way, the Orange experience literally becomes something you carry with you – personal, visible, and completely in World Cup style. “ “Je beleeft het WK pas echt Super met KPN SuperFiber” Robin Clements, commercieel directeur Consumentenmarkt KPN: “Het WK speelt zich dit keer af in het land waar alles ‘super’ is. Dan moet de beleving thuis niet achterblijven. Met KPN SuperFiber zorgen we dat je elk moment van Oranje meemaakt, alsof je er zelf bij bent: gewoon vanaf de bank.” „ KPN connected to Oranje KPN has been a partner of the KNVB for years and is committed to Dutch football across the board. From amateur football on local pitches to the Eredivisie, and from the national team to the Orange Lionesses: KPN supports the game at every level. This broad engagement stems from a clear conviction: sport connects people. On the field, on the sidelines, and at home in front of the TV. With the World Cup campaign, KPN builds on that role and demonstrates how technology and experience come together to get the whole of the Netherlands rooting for the Dutch team and for each other. title: KPN and Schwarz Digits launch European sovereign cloud in the Netherlands
text: 28 May 2026 | 07:00 Europe/Amsterdam KPN and Schwarz Digits launch European sovereign cloud in the Netherlands KPN and Schwarz Digits, the IT and digital division of Schwarz Group, are launching a European sovereign cloud for the Dutch market, as organisations seek more control over their data. This solution offers a European sovereign cloud at scale and will be hosted in KPN’s data centers in the Netherlands. KPN is responsible for connectivity and IT services, while STACKIT, the cloud platform of Schwarz Digits, provides the European cloud infrastructure. European organisations increasingly seek greater control over their data and digital infrastructure, particularly in sectors where privacy, security and resilience are critical. The solution is particularly well suited for vital organisations and sectors such as government bodies, financial services, energy and healthcare. KPN is making substantial investments in this collaboration to make this sovereign European cloud accessible in the Netherlands. This fits within the investment plans shared during the Strategy Update in November last year, with the goal to support long-term growth in the business market. European governance and open infrastructure STACKIT provides the cloud infrastructure based on open-source software. The service operates under European jurisdiction, with data processed and stored within Europe. The model supports portability and interoperability, allowing organisations to reduce dependency on individual providers and avoid vendor lock-in. STACKIT is audited against the BSI C5 criteria catalogue, a recognized benchmark at the highest security level for cloud security and transparency. Joost Farwerck, CEO of KPN: “In the Netherlands and Europe, there is a clear need for sovereign cloud solutions. Dutch companies and public organisations are increasingly looking for greater control over their data and a secure European cloud at scale. KPN is an important Dutch cloud supplier, which is part of our ‘Connect, Activate & Grow’ strategy, especially in the Business Market. Developing European sovereign cloud solutions requires action and the ability to bring together expertise and resources. That’s why I'm happy to announce our partnership today. Together we are taking an important step forward by combining the demands of our customers, our KPN expertise and the knowledge and scale of STACKIT.” Bernd Wagner, CSO of Schwarz Digits: “With the strategic partnership between KPN and Schwarz Digits, we are turning the vision of digital sovereignty in Europe into a technological reality. Through our joint go-to-market strategy, we bundle the first-class connectivity and market position of KPN with the sovereign cloud stack of STACKIT to a European powerhouse. A crucial milestone is the deep integration of our services directly into KPN's Dutch data centers. Customers can purchase the entire solution directly from KPN as their trusted partner. German companies benefit massively from the new option of seamlessly using the cloud region of the Netherlands in their existing STACKIT setup. By establishing STACKIT as a European hyperscaler, we offer an independent alternative and form the backbone for a sovereign IT infrastructure that sets a new standard.” KPN’s strategic cloud offering The collaboration with Schwarz Digits aligns with KPN’s broader strategic cloud offering, which includes public, hybrid and private cloud solutions. Different data, applications and risk levels require different approaches. With STACKIT, KPN adds a European sovereign public cloud to its portfolio, under European ownership, governance and law. Recently, KPN co-signed the Open Cloud Alliance manifesto, which aims to make digital sovereignty more practical through clear agreements on data location, transparency on access and control, and the development of Dutch and European alternatives. The solution ‘KPN Sovereign Cloud, powered by STACKIT’ is already available via the German and Austrian STACKIT cloud regions. The Netherlands-based version is expected to become available mid-2027. The solution is offered exclusively through KPN and its partners.
